name: Problem Solving
description: Systematic decomposition (MECE), root cause identification (5-Whys), and constraint optimization.

dimensions.name: MECE Decomposition
dimensions.description: Mutually Exclusive, Collectively Exhaustive issue trees breaking intractable issues down.

rubricCriteria.90-100: Flawless issue tree; zero overlap between branches, leaves no blind spots.
rubricCriteria.70-89: Strong decomposition with minor overlap or slight omission.
rubricCriteria.50-69: Messy categorization; confuses symptoms with root causes.

dimensions.name: Root Cause Analysis (5-Whys)
dimensions.description: Drilling past superficial symptoms to uncover underlying systemic failure.

rubricCriteria.90-100: Penetrates to true systemic root cause; proposes irreversible structural fix.
rubricCriteria.70-89: Finds operational root cause but misses cultural/incentive misalignment.
rubricCriteria.50-69: Fixates on proximate symptom rather than underlying driver.
rubricCriteria.0-49: Applies band-aid to superficial manifestation; problem immediately recurs.
